reason: Concepts with no primary-documentation citation independent of the official objectives source. The cause is structural rather than an oversight: the authoritative references for classical project management and business analysis (PMBOK Guide, PMI Lexicon, ISO 21500/21502, BABOK, ISO/IEC/IEEE 12207 and 29148) are paywalled, and pmi.org and gao.gov refuse automated fetches. These concepts are therefore waived from the independent-sourcing requirement, EXPLICITLY and by name, rather than passing invisibly. Question generation over these concepts (cycle 3) has no primary source to check answers against and should be gated on resolving them.
question_policy: Cycle 3 authors questions on these concepts. An item on a waived concept may only turn on a definition every consensus source agrees about; where sources differ on a point, that point is out of bounds for an item. Every such item carries waived_source: true, and tools/check-bank.mjs check q-waiver-policy counts and reports them. Established 2026-08-11 after the cluster sourcing sprint recorded in docs/verification/waiver-sprint-2026-08-11.json.
